properties.comment: Define keys for missionary ordination in Europe and colonies
properties.entry: Ordination is free and uses no movement. The colonist keeps identity, specialty, equipment and movement. Expert effects apply only to a Jesuit or while your nation holds Jean de Brebeuf.
This colonist is now a missionary. Nothing else changed.
The situation changed. Nothing was changed. Cancel and try again.
This colonist is not available for ordination on your turn. Nothing was changed.
This colonist is already a missionary. Nothing was changed.
This colonist works in a field or building. Leave that job first, then ordain.
This colonist has an active order, such as sentry, fortification or pioneer work. Cancel that order first.
Ordination needs this colonist on the European pier or standing outside the fields and buildings of your colony.
This colony needs a church or cathedral. A chapel alone is not enough.
